parsed.post: Discarding the 1.035441 run; it was a regression from my best 1.032403. It seems my previous 0.03 LR was more stable for the 524288 batch size. I'll revert to my best and try increasing the learning rate to 0.04 to see if we can gain more convergence in the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.04 to test for faster convergence within the 5-minute budget, reverting from the failed 1.035441 experiment.
